text:
marta: ACME PM pinged: their marketplace team wants a pinned ROCm/CUDA driver combo we can ship as a certified image. They reported perf regressions on ROCm 5.3 and asked for a rollback path.

shawn: Do we have a clean rollback candidate? Last stable we tested with ACME was 5.1.2 but there were quant kernel flakies.

oliver: We have `rocm-5.2-stable` branch with a small reorder patch that fixed the flakiness. No marketplace packaging yet.

jena: Marketplace needs: 1) sealed AMI/container with exact package hashes, 2) offline bundle for air-gapped SI installs, 3) rollout plan with canary window. SLA for signing is 72h.

marta: Proposed: cut hotfix branch drivers/hotfix/marketplace-rocm-5.2.2, build AMI tag `redwood-ami:rocm-5.2.2-20260322`, include drivers.tar.gz and README.marketplace. Who can own build+canary?

shawn: I can own the AMI build and canary in ACME lab. I will add a marketplace manifest file with hashes.

oliver: I'll assemble the offline bundle and generate sha256sum list. Also listing changed files: `quant_reorder.patch`, `kvcache-fix.diff`. Add changelog notes: "Fix: quant matmul ordering -> eliminate rare scoring drift".

qa-bot: triggered pipeline: `marketplace-hotfix/rocm-5.2.2` -> artifact `mkp-art-2026-03-22-11`

jena: Important: ACME requires kernel compatibility matrix (kernel versions supported). Which kernel did you build against?

oliver: Built against kernel 5.15 and 6.1 variants. We should provide both AMIs to cover their customers.

marta: Rollout suggestion: lab canary (ACME lab) 12-24h -> EU marketplace region 24h -> US region 24h -> global. Hold public comms until 48h after global. Legal to check partner co-branding.

shawn: Noted. Also found a small throughput drop for tiny batch sizes on A100 with the ROCm build. Filing ticket INF-7623 and will attach perf runs. If this persists, we should enable an automatic fallback route to our CUDA variant for A100s.

oliver: Fallback already supported via routing rules. I'll prepare a config snippet for marketplace: `routes.marketplace: - match: hw==A100 && rocm_degraded==true action: route: cuda-quant-path` and add to repo `marketplace-routing`.

marta: Action list: 1) shawn build AMIs (5.15 & 6.1) + canary (assigned), 2) oliver prepare offline bundle + changelog (assigned), 3) jena coordinate ACME signing + legal (assigned), 4) qa to run smoke/perf and post logs (assigned).

qa-bot: smoke job complete: latency median +2%, p95 unchanged, small-batch throughput -6% on A100. Logs: https://internal.redwood/jobs/INF-7623/logs.zip

shawn: Uploaded AMIs: `redwood-ami:rocm-5.2.2-20260322-k5.15` and `redwood-ami:rocm-5.2.2-20260322-k6.1`. Pushed manifest with sha256 hashes to `artifacts/marketplace/rocm-5.2.2/manifest.json`.

oliver: Bundle + README uploaded to artifacts: `drivers-rocm-5.2.2.tar.gz` and `README.marketplace.md`. README includes offline install steps and kernel notes.

jena: I scheduled ACME signing window for Monday. Legal asked for a one-line co-brand: "Redwood runtime with ACME-validated ROCm stack". Legal will review before press.

marta: Please react with :white_check_mark: when your item is done so we can tell ACME to start signing.

shawn: :white_check_mark: (AMIs + canary)

oliver: :white_check_mark: (bundle + changelog)

qa-bot: perf artifacts uploaded to https://internal.redwood/attachments/rocm-5.2.2-perf.zip

jena: :white_check_mark: (coord + legal pinged)

marta: Thanks everyone. Leaving thread open for any regressions discovered during ACME canary. Tag me or @partnerships if something blocks signing.

acme-partner-bot: ACME marketplace team notified: signing window requested. Will update status in `acme-/marketplace-signing` channel.
